mapper.select: SELECT CAST(s.record_id AS CHAR) recordId,s.request_id requestId,s.smsid, s.sender_name senderName,s.recipient_name recipientName,s.source_name sourceName, s.mobiles,s.content, CASE WHEN s.task_status='pending' AND s.create_time<DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 60 SECOND) THEN 'unknown' ELSE s.task_status END taskStatus, s.delivery_status deliveryStatus,s.platform_code platformCode,s.result_text resultText, s.platform_task_id platformTaskId,s.accepted_phones acceptedPhones, DATE_FORMAT(s.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') createTime FROM fire_sms_record s WHERE 1=1 AND (s.recipient_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR s.mobiles LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR s.source_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) AND (CASE WHEN s.task_status='pending' AND s.create_time<DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 60 SECOND) THEN 'unknown' ELSE s.task_status END)=#{taskStatus} AND s.create_time>=#{beginTime} AND s.create_time<DATE_ADD(#{endTime},INTERVAL 1 DAY) ${params.dataScope} ORDER BY s.create_time DESC,s.record_id DESC
